messages:
Nia: Alert: multiple tenants reporting SCIM 401/403 after RBAC role-map rollout. IdP logs show OIDC aud validation failures for client_id=acme-portal-legacy. Any recent client rotations?
Rahul: I rotated the oauth client ids/secrets during maintenance to retire old creds. I missed updating a batch of per-tenant SCIM connectors (my bad).
Omar: KMS telemetry shows a short spike of InvalidCiphertextException on alias/idp-service around 02:30 UTC during a key promotion (v5->v6). Could be tokens failing to decrypt.
Nia: SCIM probe logs show retries created duplicate service accounts (extId collisions) during the aud-mismatch window. Example: 2026-04-08T02:31:12Z scim: 401 aud mismatch -> later 201 created fallback user-user123-dup.
Rahul: Mitigation idea: add legacy client to gateway aud allowlist while we stage coordinated updates. @infra-bot can you apply temp change?
infra-bot: gateway.aud.allowlist += acme-portal-legacy (applied by infra-bot)
Omar: KMS team re-encrypt sweep scheduled for objects reporting decrypt failures; INF-KMS-204 alert created to track InvalidCiphertextException > 4 in 5m.
Nia: Found root cause for secret leak: a debug job wrote oauth_client_secret to s3://dev-dumps/acme/debug-20260408.log with wildcard PutObject perms.
Rahul: Immediate actions: rotate client secret, purge S3 object and older versions, revoke refresh tokens, tighten debug job IAM, run a scan for other dumps. Rotating now.
Omar: Re-encrypt sweep completed, KMS error rate returned to baseline. Requeue cleared ~28 failed items.
Rahul: Pushed SCIM idempotency patch to check extId before create and upsert instead of creating duplicates. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/scim/pull/412
Nia: Exported reconciliation file: s3://redwood-incident-exports/scim-recon-1801239999.csv. Plan to merge duplicates by extId keeping latest last_active.
oncall: PM actions: 1) require coordinated rotation checklist for client_id/secret changes (SCIM, gateway, IdP) 2) CI check to block uploads containing secrets to S3 3) Harden debug job IAM perms 4) KMS alert INF-KMS-204 5) Reconcile job to dedupe by extId + last_active 6) Only keep gateway allowlist for 24h and monitor.
Rahul: :thumbsup: will follow up with tenant notices and confirm removal of the temp allowlist after 24h if stable.
